# Zoho Calendar

Zoho Calendar manages calendars, events, availability, settings, and organizational resource bookings across Zoho data centers.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zoho-calendar/.

## Actions

- **Check Resource Booking Access** (read-only): Check whether Resource Booking is enabled for the connected Zoho account.
- **Create Calendar**: Create a personal calendar with a required name and color.
- **Create Event**: Create a timed, all-day, or recurring Zoho Calendar event without creating Zoho Meeting conferencing.
- **Create Resource Booking**: Book one or more available rooms in paid Zoho Resource Booking, optionally with attendees, groups, notifications, or a daily, weekly, or…
- **Create Resource Booking Branch**: Create a branch with buildings and floors in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Create Resource Booking Organization Settings**: Initialize organization-wide limits in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Create Resource Booking Room**: Create a room in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Create Resource Booking User Settings**: Initialize user preferences in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Create Resource Feature**: Create a feature definition in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Delete Calendar**: Permanently delete a calendar and return Zoho's deletion envelope.
- **Delete Event**: Delete an event, all following recurrences, or one recurrence instance using the latest ETag.
- **Delete Event Attachments**: Remove specified attachments from an event using its full date/time data and latest ETag.
- **Delete Resource**: Permanently delete a room resource from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Delete Resource Booking**: Permanently delete one room booking, all or future recurrence occurrences, or one selected occurrence.
- **Delete Resource Booking Branch**: Permanently delete a branch from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Delete Resource Feature**: Permanently delete a feature from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Download Event Attachment** (read-only): Download one event attachment.
- **Download Resource Image** (read-only): Download one resource image by its opaque image ID, exact provider file name, and owning resource ID.
- **Favorite Resource**: Mark one room as a favorite for the connected user.
- **Get Calendar** (read-only): Return full details for one calendar UID, including the documented default or primary aliases.
- **Get Calendar Settings** (read-only): Return the connected user's Calendar preferences.
- **Get Event** (read-only): Return full details for one event or a specified recurrence instance.
- **Get Group Attendee Statuses** (read-only): Return member RSVP statuses for one group attendee on an event.
- **Get Resource Booking** (read-only): Return one room booking or a specified recurrence occurrence from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Get Resource Booking Branch** (read-only): Return one Resource Booking branch with its buildings and floors.
- **Get Resource Booking Organization Settings** (read-only): Return organization-wide policy settings from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Get Resource Booking Resource** (read-only): Return one room from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Get Resource Booking User Settings** (read-only): Return user preferences from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Get Resource Feature** (read-only): Return one feature definition from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Get Resource Free Busy** (read-only): Return strict date-keyed busy intervals for one room resource over an exact inclusive date range.
- **Get User Free Busy** (read-only): Return event-based or time-based free/busy data for one email and exact local-naive time range.
- **List Calendar Shares** (read-only): Return user and group sharing entries for one calendar.
- **List Calendars** (read-only): Return calendars visible to the connected user, optionally by documented category and hidden status.
- **List Event Instances** (read-only): Return recurrence instances for one repeating event in a required range of at most 90 days.
- **List Events** (read-only): Return events in one calendar for a required range of at most 31 days.
- **List Favorite Resources** (read-only): Return the connected user's favorite room resources from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **List My Resource Bookings** (read-only): Return the connected user's room bookings for an exact date range.
- **List Resource Availability** (read-only): Return room resources and availability for a branch, optional building or floor, and an exact date/time range.
- **List Resource Booking Branches** (read-only): Return all branches from paid Zoho Resource Booking, including their buildings and floors.
- **List Resource Booking User Settings** (read-only): List user settings for at least one branch, building, or floor in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **List Resource Bookings** (read-only): Return bookings for selected rooms in a paid Zoho Resource Booking branch.
- **List Resource Features** (read-only): Return all feature definitions from paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **List Resources** (read-only): Return room resources for at least one branch, building, or floor.
- **Move Event**: Move an event between personal or group calendars, optionally changing documented event details.
- **Replace Event**: Replace an event using complete date/time data and its latest ETag, without adding Zoho Meeting conferencing.
- **Unfavorite Resource**: Remove one room from the connected user's favorites.
- **Update Calendar**: Update one or more documented properties of an existing calendar.
- **Update Calendar Settings**: Update a non-empty set of the connected user's documented Calendar preferences.
- **Update Calendar Share**: Supports add, edit, and revoke modes for one user or group calendar share.
- **Update Event**: Partially update event fields or attendee data using exactly one documented payload.
- **Update Resource**: Update a room, its feature assignments, or its visibility in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Update Resource Booking**: Update a room booking or selected recurrence occurrences in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Update Resource Booking Branch**: Update a branch or add or remove its buildings and floors in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Update Resource Booking Organization Settings**: Update organization-wide booking limits in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Update Resource Booking User Settings**: Update user preferences in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Update Resource Feature**: Rename or hide a feature in paid Zoho Resource Booking.
- **Upload Event Attachment**: Upload one file of at most 10,240 kB.
